mentions.name: DrawX
mentions.description: A drawing app built on Excalidraw that adds a backend, letting users save their drawings and create and manage multiple canvases without needing Excalidraw+.
mentions.problem: Excalidraw lacks a backend for saving work and managing multiple canvases unless you pay for Excalidraw+, which the author didn't need.
mentions.source_excerpt:
DrawX is Excalidraw with backend.

I love Excalidraw but I don't need Excalidraw+ I just need the backend where I can save and be able to create multiple canvases.

So that's what I built!
